summary: Full-stack testing of Merkabah Creative Life MVP. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passed (root, JWT login/me, seeded content, all 6 public forms + their appearance in admin dashboard, admin auth guard, search). Frontend: verified home hero + 9 world cards, navbar CTA, agency enquiry form, academy trial form, academy 5 instruments, courses list, live event, journal article, internships consent+submit, contact form, admin login → dashboard tab shows submitted contact record, and search page renders (results verified via backend). Two frontend selector-only failures in the test script (not app bugs) — see notes below.

minor.issue: allow_origins=["*"] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec — browsers will reject credentialed requests from a real cross-origin. Currently the frontend is same-origin (routed via ingress) and uses Bearer header, so this doesn't break anything today, but it's a latent bug if the app is ever accessed cross-origin. Recommend echoing the request Origin or setting FRONTEND_URL explicitly.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting (playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails). Not implemented — acceptable for MVP but noted.
Response shape differs between new subscribe (returns full doc) and dedupe (returns {ok, message}). Consider normalizing.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix CORS config — cannot use allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True. Set explicit origins from FRONTEND_URL env.
OPTIONAL: Add brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (mentioned in playbook_testing_instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 350-line file — acceptable at this size but split by domain (auth/, forms/, admin/, content/) if it grows further.
CORS: allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is a spec violation; browsers ignore credentials on wildcard origins.
Seed function correctly hashes with bcrypt ($2b$) and re-hashes when password changes — good and idempotent.

Public GET /api/content/{coll} filters by published=True by default but exposes ?published_only= query — fine, no admin data leak because it's still filter-only, but confirm no draft leakage in frontend usage.

admin_update/admin_delete accept any coll not restricted to COLLECTIONS list — a determined admin could edit users collection via /api/admin/users. Since only admins can call it, low severity, but recommend restricting to allowed list like admin_list does.
No pagination on admin_list / content list (to_list(500/1000)) — fine for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (2 script-selector issues, not app bugs)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds on startup: admin user, 5 courses (Piano/Guitar/Violin/Drums/Vocals), 1 event (Merkabah Live: Acoustic Sessions), 1 article (Why We Named It Merkabah). Verified via GET /api/content/*.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical paths incl. form→admin visibility. Two known test-script quirks: (a) home hero text is split across multiple text nodes so `text=Create. Learn. Experience. Grow.` selector fails — use partial match or data-testid; (b) /search page uses a plain <input> (no type=search) with placeholder 'Search courses, events, journal, jobs, store...' — either add data-testid or match by placeholder. Both are UI-side improvements only, no functional issue.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Every form endpoint POSTs successfully, records persist in MongoDB, and each appears in the corresponding /api/admin/{coll} response and in the admin dashboard tab UI.
